testcase.name: a motorway leave is worded as a leave
a name change says which street the route continues on
the keep wording follows the move as well
a motorway entry carries the signposted destination
a named turn composes the street into the row
an unmapped manoeuvre renders the neutral wording
an empty street leaves the manoeuvre alone
a plain turn does not show a destination record it carries

testcase.name: every turn move has its own wording
a roundabout leave without an ordinal does not invent one
a motorway manoeuvre without a destination keeps today's wording
a motorway enter names the motorway entered
a motorway change carries the signposted destination
a roundabout enter is the bare roundabout
a motorway change is worded as a keep onto the next motorway
the start and the arrival carry no street composition
a roundabout leave names its ordinal
